init.title: Venice AI Options
init.description: Configure Venice AI conversation, voice, and model settings.

data_description.chat_model: Only models with function-calling support are listed (models marked 🔍 also support web search). See venice.ai/models for the full list.
data_description.prompt: The system prompt sent to the AI before every conversation. Supports {{ha_name}}, {{user_name}}, and {{llm_context}} placeholders.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Expose Home Assistant tools (entities, scripts, etc.) to the AI so it can control your smart home. Select 'Assist' to use the standard HA tool set.
data_description.temperature: Controls response randomness. Lower values (e.g. 0.2) = focused and deterministic. Higher values (e.g. 1.5) = creative and varied. Default 0.7, range 0–2.
data_description.top_p: Nucleus sampling: only the top tokens whose combined probability reaches this threshold are considered. Lower = safer output. Default 0.9, range 0–1. Tune Temperature OR Top P, not both.
data_description.max_tokens: Maximum number of tokens the model may generate per reply. 2048 covers most conversations; increase for long-form output. Range 1–32768.
data_description.strip_thinking_response: For reasoning models only. Removes the internal chain-of-thought block before showing the reply to the user.
data_description.disable_thinking: For reasoning models only. Skips the reasoning step entirely — faster responses but less depth on complex questions.
data_description.continue_conversation: Keep the microphone open after the AI responds with a question, enabling back-and-forth voice conversations without pressing a button.
data_description.enable_web_search: Allow the AI to search the web when answering questions. Only available on models marked 🔍 in the model list.
data_description.max_tool_iterations: How many tool-call rounds the agent may run per user message before it stops and returns what it has. Higher values allow more complex multi-step tasks.
data_description.context_threshold: When the conversation exceeds this many tokens, the oldest messages are automatically trimmed to keep the context window under the model's limit.
data_description.tts_enabled: Register Venice AI as a Text-to-Speech provider so voice assistant pipelines can use it for spoken responses.
data_description.tts_model: The Venice AI model used for speech synthesis.
data_description.tts_response_format: Audio format returned by the TTS API. MP3 is the most compatible; WAV is uncompressed; OGG is smaller.
data_description.stt_enabled: Register Venice AI as a Speech-to-Text provider so voice assistant pipelines can use it to transcribe spoken input.
data_description.stt_model: The Venice AI model used for speech transcription.
data_description.stt_response_format: Format of the transcription response. JSON includes metadata; text is plain; verbose_json adds word-level detail; SRT/VTT are subtitle formats.
data_description.stt_timestamps: Include word-level timestamps in the transcription response. Requires verbose_json response format.

skills_and_tools.title: Skills & Function Calling

data_description.skills: Skills inject extra instructions and context into the system prompt. **How to add a skill:** Create a folder at `config/custom_components/venice_ai/skills/[skill-name]/` and place a `SKILL.md` file inside it describing what the skill does. After adding files, use the 'Reload Skills' service to pick them up without restarting. Only skills found on disk appear here.
